svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 920 x 520 x 2 mm; round the corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Intake slot 400 x 80 mm, centred, 30 to 110 mm up from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge; a 410 x 90 x 10 mm filter pad held behind it by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a folded sheet clip frame (four rivets).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cam lock: 19 mm hole 420 mm right of centre, 260 mm up; the cam

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: arm turns behind the panel edge, 60 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge: stainless piano hinge 460 mm long, riveted to the door's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front along its left edge and to the panel beside the opening.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gasket: 7 x 3 mm EPDM strip round the opening, 1 mm out from it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: covers the 900 x 500 opening with 10 mm overlap all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the cam pulls the door tight onto the gasket.
